questions.subject: English
questions.q: He has a great appetite ___ knowledge.
questions.explain: Appetite for = কোনো কিছুর প্রতি ক্ষুধা/আগ্রহ। বাংলা: জ্ঞানের প্রতি তার প্রবল আগ্রহ আছে।

questions.subject: English
questions.q: You must conform ___ the rules of the institution.
questions.explain: Conform to = নিয়ম মেনে চলা। Conform with = কারো সাথে মিলে যাওয়া। Rules এর সাথে to হয়।

questions.subject: English
questions.q: He was introduced ___ the chairman.
questions.explain: Introduce to a person = কারো সাথে পরিচয় করিয়ে দেওয়া। Introduce into = কোনো স্থানে প্রবেশ করানো।

questions.subject: English
questions.q: He conforms ___ my opinion.
questions.explain: Conform with = কারো মতের সাথে একমত হওয়া। ব্যক্তির মতের সাথে with হয়।

questions.subject: English
questions.q: The book was introduced ___ the market last week.
questions.explain: Introduce into = বাজারে / কোথাও নতুন কিছু আনা। Person হলে to, place/market হলে into।

questions.subject: English
questions.q: I have no appetite ___ food today.
questions.explain: Appetite for + noun সবসময় for হয়।

questions.subject: English
questions.q: We should conform ___ the customs of the society.
questions.explain: Customs, rules, regulations, law - এগুলোর সাথে conform to বসে।

questions.subject: English
questions.q: Let me introduce my friend ___ you.
questions.explain: Introduce somebody to somebody = একজনকে আরেকজনের সাথে পরিচয় করানো।

questions.subject: English
questions.q: His actions do not conform ___ the agreement.
questions.explain: Agreement, terms, conditions এর সাথে conform to হয়।

questions.subject: English
questions.q: She has a strong appetite ___ success.
questions.explain: Appetite for success = সফলতার জন্য তীব্র আকাঙ্ক্ষা।

questions.subject: English
questions.q: He was introduced ___ smoking by his friends.
questions.explain: Introduce to + habit = কোনো অভ্যাসের সাথে পরিচিত করানো। He was introduced to smoking.

questions.subject: English
questions.q: Your conduct does not conform ___ our expectations.
questions.explain: Expectations, standards এর সাথে conform to।

questions.subject: English
questions.q: The new teacher was introduced ___ the class.
questions.explain: Class = group of persons, তাই introduce to the class।

questions.subject: English
questions.q: She has no appetite ___ music.
questions.explain: Appetite for + noun = আগ্রহ। সবসময় for।

questions.subject: English
questions.q: They refused to conform ___ the new policy.
questions.explain: Policy, rule, law এর সাথে conform to।

questions.subject: English
questions.q: I was introduced ___ her at the party.
questions.explain: Introduce to someone at somewhere।

questions.subject: English
questions.q: He has an appetite ___ adventure.
questions.explain: Appetite for adventure = রোমাঞ্চের প্রতি আকর্ষণ।

questions.subject: English
questions.q: We must conform ___ the decision of the majority.
questions.explain: Decision, opinion যদি system/rule হিসেবে থাকে তবে to, ব্যক্তির মত হিসেবে with। এখানে decision = to।

questions.subject: English
questions.q: He introduced a new method ___ farming.
questions.explain: Introduce into + field/activity = কোনো ক্ষেত্রে নতুন পদ্ধতি আনা।

questions.subject: English
questions.q: Which one is correct? - He has appetite ___ wealth.
questions.explain: Appetite for wealth = সম্পদের প্রতি লোভ। Appropriate preposition সবসময় for।
